An army lieutenant who overthrew Modibo Keita in 1968 and ruled Mali until 26 March 1991.

His one-party state faced the Sahel droughts, debt and student protests. In March 1991 troops fired on pro-democracy crowds in Bamako, killing many, and officers led by Amadou Toumani Toure arrested him. A national conference and elections followed, and Mali became, for two decades, a model of African democracy, until the crisis of the Mali War. Traore was sentenced to death twice, the sentences commuted, and later pardoned.
sum: An army lieutenant who overthrew Modibo Keita in 1968 and ruled Mali until 26 March 1991.
